publisher: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Office of the Actuary
title_or_table: National Health Expenditures by source of funds, folded by the studio into four groups
universe_or_base: All national health expenditures, by who paid, in four groups
unit: millions of dollars, nominal, and each group's percent of the year's total, computed by the studio; empty where a program did not yet exist (Medicare and Medicaid before 1966). A chart over 64 years draws the percent columns, since nominal dollars hide the mix behind inflation
qualification: All other sources of funds is the total minus private health insurance, Medicare and Medicaid: out of pocket; CHIP; the Departments of Defense and Veterans Affairs; other third party payers and programs; and public health activity and investment, which are spending, not payers, so the group is named sources of funds. Out of pocket is its largest part, and a note names it
derivation: Keeps private health insurance, Medicare and Medicaid as published, sums every other line into all other sources of funds as total minus the three, and gives each group's percent of the total

all_other_sources_millions.description: all other sources of funds, computed

printed_source_line: Source: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, National Health Expenditure Accounts, spending by source of funds, 1960 to 2024, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Shares of each year’s total; all other sources of funds, out of pocket the largest, folded into one group by Oath & Action.

source_line_variants.release_named: Source: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, National Health Expenditure Accounts, release with data through 2024, spending by source of funds, 1960 to 2024, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Shares of each year’s total; all other sources of funds, out of pocket the largest, folded into one group by Oath & Action. Each release can revise every earlier year.

notes: Release, read November 12, 2026 (statistics review S6): CMS’s historical page (https://www.cms.gov/data-research/statistics-trends-and-reports/national-health-expenditure-data/historical, "Page Last Modified: 01/14/2026") posts the release with data through 2024 ("National Health Expenditures 2024 Highlights") and names no release date; its zip file, read again, equals cms-nhe-by-source-of-funds.csv in all 715 cells. CMS’s "Summary of the 2024 Comprehensive Revision" says that in a comprehensive revision "the entire NHEA time series is opened for revision", so variant release_named names the release and says earlier years can change
